From: Emily Jensen <emily@stellarretail.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: breakdown of per-subroute cost for June spike

Hi Sofia —

Thanks again for the quick sync on Friday. We pushed a minor UI change on our side and saw a ~3x token spend increase for one route in June; overall tenant spend jumped and our finance team wants a clearer breakdown by sub-route (we call them "flows") so they can map to customer-facing features.

Can Redwood provide: a per-subroute token & latency breakdown for tenant: stellar-retail-prod (June 1–30), ownership guidance for alerts, and an example playbook we can use for cost-attribution reviews?

I've attached a sample CSV with our flow mapping and can loop in procurement if we need contract changes.

Appreciate any help — if you prefer a short working session, we can do 30 minutes next week.

Best,
Emily Jensen
Head of Platform Analytics
Stellar Retail

Folks — forwarding Emily's request. Stellar is asking for: per-subroute token & latency breakdown for June, suggested alerting/ownership playbook, and a lightweight dashboard/wireframe they can use. They included a mapping of their flows (attached).

Quick asks:
- Can Observability produce a one-off CSV with per-subroute token counts, p50/p95 latency, and top contributing prompts for the tenant?
- Product: what is the minimum viable ownership model we can recommend (roles, alert thresholds, who to ping)?
- UX: can we mock a single-pane wireframe (they want a copyable template)?

I'll coordinate a 30-minute working session Thurs 10am PT if that works. Emily, can you confirm?

Thanks,

Sofia — happy to own the data extract. I can export per-endpoint and per-route token totals and include latency percentiles. A couple notes:
- We'll need their internal flow->route mapping (Emily attached CSV; looks usable).
- For "top contributing prompts" we can provide top-50 input prefixes by token volume and attach as CSV.
- Cost attribution: token counts + model variant mapping will be required; if they use fallbacks we should mark those requests.

I'll attach a sample wireframe for a one-pane view and a quick playbook draft for alert thresholds. Can the product/UX folks sign off on thresholds (p95 latency > 1.2s for NLU flows? token spend > 2x baseline over rolling 7 days?).

I'll aim to have the export + draft playbook ready before the Thurs 10am PT workshop.

-Marcus
Staff Software Engineer, Observability

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 24 Jul 2028 11:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: breakdown of per-subroute cost for June spike

Thanks Marcus — this looks good. Two product-level comments from my side:

1) Ownership model: recommend a lightweight triage owner (engineer on call) + business owner (customer success), with a weekly cost review for tenants in "watch" state. Template: OOO owner -> oncall -> CSM escalation.
2) Alert thresholds: prefer relative thresholds for customers with volatile usage (e.g., spend > 150% baseline) and absolute thresholds for enterprise accounts (e.g., > $5k/day). We'll supply baseline estimates for Stellar after the export.

Camila — can you add a short paragraph to the playbook about how to neutralize spikes (cache warmers, prefix caching, traffic shaping)? Aditya — can you confirm whether we can include a tenant-level fallback policy suggestion in the playbook (model variant swap if cost exceeds X)?

Kimberly
Group PM, Platform Insights
